title: PairResponse
description: 200 body of POST /api/v1/pair (QR pairing, LSP-1 sections 4.3.4 and 5.3; LSP/1.1 secure profile, Increment 3). `accepted:true`: the inviter's user pressed Accept; `nonce` is nA (16 random bytes) and `mac = HMAC-SHA256(S, "LSP1-PAIR-ACK\0" || fpA || fpB || nA || nB)` proves the inviter holds `S`; both sides then derive K_pair locally (it never travels) and pin each other as trusted. `accepted:false`: the inviter declined or did not decide within 125 s; `nonce` and `mac` are absent. A request with a wrong `mac`, no active invite, or an expired or spent invite is NOT answered with this body (401 AUTH_INVALID resp. 404 NOT_FOUND). Mirrors PairResponse in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

responder.description: The inviter's DeviceInfo; its `fingerprint` MUST equal the fingerprint of the TLS certificate (and of the QR code).

nonce.description: nA: 16 random bytes, base64url, 22 characters. Present iff accepted.

mac.description: Confirmation HMAC-SHA256 (32 bytes), base64url, 43 characters. Present iff accepted.
